court_allocations_kind_matches_source.name: court_allocations_kind_matches_source
court_allocations_kind_matches_source.value: ("court_allocations"."kind" = 'booking' and "court_allocations"."booking_item_id" is not null) or ("court_allocations"."kind" = 'checkout_hold' and "court_allocations"."checkout_hold_item_id" is not null) or ("court_allocations"."kind" = 'merchant_block' and "court_allocations"."court_block_id" is not null)

price_rules_type_fields.name: price_rules_type_fields
price_rules_type_fields.value: ("price_rules"."type" = 'recurring' and "price_rules"."day_of_week" is not null and "price_rules"."special_date" is null) or ("price_rules"."type" = 'special_date' and "price_rules"."special_date" is not null) or ("price_rules"."type" = 'seasonal' and "price_rules"."active_from" is not null and "price_rules"."active_until" is not null)

schedule_overrides_valid_period.name: schedule_overrides_valid_period
schedule_overrides_valid_period.value: "schedule_overrides"."is_closed" or ("schedule_overrides"."opens_at" is not null and "schedule_overrides"."closes_at" is not null and "schedule_overrides"."opens_at" < "schedule_overrides"."closes_at")
